title: Watershed-only sensitivity: livestock at facilities outside the permit system (REFRAMED; formerly 'census_undercount_factor')
description: REFRAMED v3. Kast et al. (2019) compared barn-imagery livestock estimates (EWG 2019, 2018 imagery) with permitted-CAFO / 2012-Census-bounded estimates for the Ohio Maumee watershed and found more animals than the permit-based accounting (cattle +54%, swine +30%, poultry +544%). This is evidence of a REGULATORY gap (animals at unpermitted, smaller facilities), NOT evidence that the USDA Census undercounts animals. The factor is therefore a watershed-only sensitivity for analyses that start from permit records; it must NOT be applied to NASS Census county totals. Default 1.0 (no adjustment). run_counties ignores values other than 1.0 unless --allow-watershed-factor is given, and labels outputs accordingly.
scope: watershed-only (Maumee, Ohio); not national; not a census correction

provenance.source: Kast JB, Long CM, Muenich RL, Martin JF, Kalcic MM (2019) Manure management at ultra-high resolution: Insights from the Maumee River watershed. J. Great Lakes Res. 45:1162-1170, doi:10.1016/j.jglr.2019.09.015; EWG (2019) Explosion of unregulated factory farms in Maumee watershed fuels Lake Erie's toxic blooms
provenance.status: VERIFIED (figures as read in Phase 2 gap-fill task); interpretation corrected by Alex Neumann

title: Fill for NASS county cow counts withheld as (D)
description: 'sizeclass' (default): state residual allocated by size-class estimates (livingghg.gapfill; validation by masking 20% of disclosed counties: milk cows median 21.5% / head-weighted 22.9% abs error, beef cows 3.6% / 6.7%). 'prior_census': USGS approach, most recent disclosed value in 2017/2012/2007/2002 Census (Falcone 2021); not constrained to 2022 state totals. 'none': withheld = 0.

provenance.source: USDA NASS Census of Agriculture 2002-2022 Quick Stats bulk files; Falcone JA (2021) USGS Open-File Report 2020-1153 and data release doi:10.5066/P9VSQN3C

title: Non-cattle manure N applied to soil (F_ON)
description: 'noncattle_excreted' (default): F_ON = Falcone 2021 county 2017 excreted manure N for hogs + poultry + other (upper bound: no storage/handling losses). Cattle manure N is excluded because cattle are modelled explicitly (pasture N enters as F_PRP_CPP); applied managed cattle manure is NOT counted (known limitation, underestimate). 'none': F_ON = 0.

provenance.source: Falcone JA (2021) Estimates of county-level nitrogen and phosphorus from fertilizer and manure from 1950 through 2017 in the conterminous United States, USGS data release doi:10.5066/P9VSQN3C (manure2017.txt)
